name: Pasquiers 2025 rituximab ANCA/gammaglobulin PK/PD
description: Source-complete fixed-effect ODE reconstruction of the Pasquiers et al. 2025 real-world rituximab PK/PD model in ANCA-associated vasculitis. Runtime includes two-compartment rituximab PK, indirect gammaglobulin turnover inhibited by rituximab, and the Bensalem/Friberg ANCA production-blood feedback model. Exact API anchors replay the public article and supplement tables; dynamic regimen scenarios attach paper final-model simulation endpoints as overlays. Exact 1000-virtual-patient Monolix parity is source-limited because random-effect draws, patient data, and source simulation outputs are not public.
